overview.description: The State Street Real Estate Select Sector SPDR Premium Income ETF (XLRI) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P Real Estate Select Sector index. The fund is an actively managed fund-of-fund that holds the Real Estate Select Sector SPDR Fund (XLRE). It aims to provide additional income through selling short-dated listed call options. XLRI was launched on Jul 29, 2025 and is issued by State Street.
